entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Finally! I've been waiting forever. Listen, I bought a jersey from you people almost three months ago and it's been sitting in my closet. It's the wrong size and I want to return it. Now.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have the order number handy?
Yes, it's VF88602. Don't tell me I'm past some ridiculous return window. This jersey is brand new, I tried it on once and it's way too tight. It's completely useless to me.
Thank you for that, one moment while I pull up the details... Okay, I see the order for the Pro-Vent jersey, delivered about 85 days ago. You're saying it's the wrong size, correct?

Did you not hear me? Yes, it's the wrong size! I need to exchange it or get my money back. If you give me any trouble on this, I'm lighting you up on every review site and social media platform I can find. I expect a full refund.
I understand your frustration, sir. Let me just confirm our policy. One moment.
There's nothing to confirm! Just process the return! This is absurd. Get me your manager if you can't handle this simple request.

That won't be necessary, sir. I've just confirmed and you're well within our 90-day return window for standard items. Since you need an exchange because the jersey is too tight, I can process this for you right now. I'm sending a pre-paid return label to the email on file. You can send the original item back, and once we receive it, we can either issue a full refund or send you the correct size. Which would you prefer?
Fine. Just send the return label. I'll decide later. It should have been this easy from the start.
Of course. The email with the label has just been sent. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
